target: unchanged v1/v2 metered sensor-time occupancy rate; 15-minute expiry and 25% coverage; no row filtering by error or feature completeness
selection_objective: pooled rolling chronological AND inner-geographic validation mean squared error
cluster_basis: KMeans on street center coordinates of development blocks, fixed seed, no target values; hold out both sides of every physical block
calibration_status: Later-time calibration in development geography; independently unseen geographic calibration unavailable
auxiliary_heads: Count and binary panel-vacancy heads use the validation-selected regression feature family, with their own MSE/Brier parameter selection; no probability derived from rate
count_binary_panel_size: Known discovery-roster size only; never interpreted as full-curb capacity

new_untouched_archive_holdout.status: reserved before tuning, outcomes not requested or opened

new_untouched_manual_holdout.status: reserved before tuning; whole blocks and sessions; no observations collected

prior_holdouts: Keep September 21-30 and November 7-14 reservations unopened; no later outcomes used for selection
legacy_benchmarks: Existing north area and August 25-31 have been inspected; diagnostics only after validation choices are saved
business_and_event_snapshots: prospective only; never backfilled into historical validation
street_geometry_tier: October 2026 mapping; retrospective exploratory feature tier, not verified historical supply or legal capacity
unknown_supply_and_rules: retain null; historic curb polygons are not stalls
sensor_availability: event-time replay assumes immediate delivery; new poll recorder will retain actual first-seen timestamps prospectively
unmetered_labels: direct reviewed labels required; none acquired
